content:
Track: SQL Foundations
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
   - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
   - Lesson 3: Joins (INNER, OUTER, LEFT)
   - Lesson 4: WHERE and HAVING Clauses
   - Lesson 5: Data Manipulation with UPDATE and DELETE
   - Lesson 6: Subqueries and Nested Queries
   - Lesson 7: Functions (COUNT, AVG, MAX, MIN)
   - Lesson 8: Advanced Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses
   - Lesson 9: Data Export and Import with SQL
   - Lesson 10: Performance Optimization Techniques

   Track: Data Cleaning with Python
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 2: Working with Libraries (Pandas, NumPy)
   - Lesson 3: Reading and Writing CSV Files in Pandas
   - Lesson 4: Basic Data Manipulation (reshaping, filtering)
   - Lesson 5: Handling Missing Values
   - Lesson 6: Data Transformation Techniques (casting, normalization)
   - Lesson 7: Removing Duplicates and Outliers
   - Lesson 8: Advanced Cleaning Methods (regular expressions)

   Track: Exploratory Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to EDA
   - Lesson 2: Summarizing Data with Descriptive Statistics
   - Lesson 3: Visualizing Distributions with Histograms and Box Plots
   - Lesson 4: Correlation Matrix and Heatmaps
   - Lesson 5: Pair Plot Analysis
   - Lesson 6: Time-Series Analysis (Line Plots, Area Charts)
   - Lesson 7: Data Transformation Techniques for EDA
   - Lesson 8: Interpreting Results and Identifying Patterns

   Track: Data Visualization with Matplotlib
   - Lesson 1: Intro to Matplotlib and Line Charts
   - Lesson 2: Creating Bar Plots and Histograms
   - Lesson 3: Scatter Plots and Heatmaps
   - Lesson 4: Area Charts and Stacked Bar Plots
   - Lesson 5: Contour Plots and Surface Plots
   - Lesson 6: Customizing Plot Properties (colors, labels)
   - Lesson 7: Saving and Exporting Visualizations
   - Lesson 8: Building Interactive Dashboards with Bokeh or Plotly

   Track: Introduction to Statistics
   - Lesson 1: Descriptive Statistics Recap
   - Lesson 2: Probability Theory
   - Lesson 3: Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode)
   - Lesson 4: Measures of Dispersion (Variance, Standard Deviation)
   - Lesson 5: Confidence Intervals and Hypothesis Testing
   - Lesson 6: Correlation Analysis
   - Lesson 7: Linear Regression and Simple Linear Regression
   - Lesson 8: Inferential Statistics for Data Analysis

   Track: Data Manipulation with Excel
   - Lesson 1: Importing and Exporting Data from Excel
   - Lesson 2: Basic Data Manipulation (filtering, sorting)
   - Lesson 3: Advanced Formulas and Functions
   - Lesson 4: Pivot Tables and Cross-Tabulations
   - Lesson 5: Conditional Formatting and Cell References
   - Lesson 6: Macros and VBA Scripting (optional)
   - Lesson 7: Data Visualization with Excel Charts
   - Lesson 8: Sharing and Collaborating on Excel Workbooks
